description: Draft task skill; unqualified and not published.

when_not_to_use: Do not execute a trade or represent an owner decision as complete.

expected_outputs.name: task_result
expected_outputs.description: Use task-specific result fields in references/schemas.json#/definitions/output; preserve nulls, ambiguity and gaps.

forbidden_actions: No orders, trade copying, live monitoring, signing, deployment, or capital activation.
No invented values, returns, probabilities, fills, or confidence.
No new spend, provider calls, credentials, or external mutation.
No evaluation, certification, admission, release, or publication claim.
verification_steps: Inspect input/output units, denominators, time window and evidence provenance.
Inspect assumptions, ambiguity, limitations and alternative explanations.
Confirm owner handoffs and no external action.
completion_criteria: Task-specific deliverable fields are present or explicitly marked missing.
Scope, uncertainty and owner handoffs are stated.
known_limitations: Proposed fixtures are not evaluated; no live data or provider operation was performed.
